To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions have a significant impact on behavioral intention of healthcare users to adopt the cloud-based health system, but data security and information sharing have a significant impact.

performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, data security, and information sharing are significant factors affecting behavioral intention to adopt cloud-based health center, while cloud-based health knowledge is not significant.

the performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, data security, and information sharing had a significant impact, while cloud-based health knowledge had no significant impact on healthcare consumers' behavioral intention toward the adoption of cloud-based health system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors affecting healthcare consumers attitude toward cloud-based health center adoption.
the factors affecting the successful adoption of cloud-based health systems from healthcare consumers’ perspective.
how healthcare consumers’ behavior toward cloud-based health center adoption is affected by the factors identified in this research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the adoption of cloud-based health centers by healthcare consumers is influenced by the performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, data security, information sharing, but not cloud-based health knowledge.
the cloud-based health system has the potential to improve healthcare delivery and reduce cost/time in the healthcare industry.

the adoption of cloud-based health centers by healthcare consumers is dependent on performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, data security, and information sharing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cloud-based health system will not be accepted if the healthcare consumers’ behavioral intention is not considered.

the cloud-based health system can be successfully adopted by healthcare consumers in Nigeria if it can provide performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions.

cloud-based health center is not a one-size-fits-all solution to all healthcare consumers’ problems, and it is therefore imperative that healthcare policy makers should consider the factors affecting the adoption of cloud-based health system from the perspective of the healthcare consumers before its implementation in Nigeria.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cloud-based health center is a viable technology for healthcare service delivery in Nigeria.
the healthcare policy makers must be cautious before implementing the cloud-based health system in the Nigerian healthcare system, otherwise, it will continue to create challenges.

healthcare consumers’ behavioral intention toward the adoption of e-health cloud-based health center is influenced by their performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions.
